XData.name: Contents
XData.Description: This XML block defines the contents of this page.
XData.Data:
<page xmlns="http://www.intersystems.com/zen" title="Interface Team Login" width="100%"> <hgroup width="98%" align="center"> <image id="TemplateLogo" align="left" width="150"/> <label id="title" value="Interface Team - Source Control / Deployment" align="left"/> </hgroup> <cssGroup> <!-- put page contents here --> <combobox id="comboboxFunction" editable="false" dropdownHeight="100" selectedIndex="1"> <option value="srcCtrl" text="Source Control"/> <option value="deploy" text="Deployment"/> <option value="setting" text="Settings"/> <option value="getRecords" text="GetRecords"/> <option value="resend" text="Resend"/> </combobox>
<label id="lblUsername" value="Username" align="center" />
<button id="buttonLogin" caption="Go" onclick="zenPage.validateFields();" /> <label id="lblAccess" value="Access Denied" hidden="true" enclosingClass="badLabel" /> </cssGroup> </page>

Method.name: ValidateSubversionUser
Method.Implementation:
#dim %page as %ZEN.Component.page set stat = $$$OK Try { set pPassword = "" set pUser = "" Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).ClearItfDebug($USERNAME) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($USERNAME, $SYSTEM _ ", " _ $NAMESPACE _ ", " _ $ZV _ ", " _ $USERNAME _", " _ $THIS) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($USERNAME, $SYSTEM _ ": " _ $ZDATETIME($HOROLOG) _ " In ValidateSubversionUser for: " _ $USERNAME) set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).ValidateUser($USERNAME, .pUser, .pPassword) if (stat '= 0) { Do %page.%SetValueById("lblAccess","Could not access Subversion " _ $$$SVNSRCURL _ " for " _ $USERNAME) Set %page.%GetComponentById("lblAccess").hidden = 0 RETURN stat } else { set %session.Data("svnPsWd") = pPassword set %session.Data("svnUsrNm") = pUser
set %session.Data("srcHistPsWd") = "ITF_Services" set %session.Data("srcHistUsrNm") = "ITF_Services"
set %session.Data("UsNm") = $USERNAME Set %session.AppTimeout = 3600 // set timeout to 1 hour set tStat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).CheckSvnSetup($USERNAME, pPassword) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($USERNAME, "SVN Login successful for " _ $USERNAME _ " / " _ pUser _", stat: " _ stat) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($USERNAME, "Using user: " _ %session.Data("srcHistUsrNm") _ " to access Ensemble History instance") } // &js<alert('Server Method');> } Catch(ex) { &js<alert('Could not run SVN command to check the User, possible permission issue, error in Server method:\n#($ZCVT(ex.DisplayString(),"O","JS"))#');> RETURN 1 } RETURN 0
